page.overview:
Who is Bigfoot's Capturer?

Bigfoot's Capturer is a man who showed up at the Springfield National Forest after rumors of Bigfoot appearing here (which was just Homer covered in mud). When Homer and Bart come back from taking Maggie out of the bear cave, the Bigfoot Kid mistakes Homer for Bigfoot, so he points it out to the others, and the Bigfoot capturer traps Homer in a net as Bart and Maggie run away from getting captured. Not long later, Homer escapes from the net, but gets shot with an animal tranquilizer gun.
